input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: Section 3.4(b) conditions our termination for convenience on payment of "early termination charges" that are Customer-payable and set solely by reference to Attachment A and Service Option Attachments, which are not part of this Agreement's text and impose no ceiling. That is an uncapped liquidated amount payable by us, which fails both the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer) and the fallback (early-termination fee capped at three months' fees as the sole liquidated amount); an unquantified charge could reach or exceed remaining contract value, which is walk-away territory. No other Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties appear in the document (the search for "liquidated damages" returned nothing; §§ 3.5, 4.1 and 4.2 contain only accrued-charge and late-payment obligations, which are ordinary payment terms). Because the convenience right is itself a benefit we bargained for and the rule's redline guidance expressly contemplates a cap where an early-termination fee is unavoidable, we take the fallback rather than deleting the charge outright: three months' Charges, as the sole liability and exclusive remedy. This also preserves the existing protection in § 3.3 that IBM cannot recover these charges where IBM is the breaching party.

proposal.summary: Cap Customer-payable early termination charges at three months' fees as the sole such amount
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that no liquidated damages or penalties are payable by us, so we have capped the early termination charges at three months' Charges as the sole amount due on termination for convenience. This keeps the convenience right meaningful and matches the accepted three-month fallback.

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, provided that such early termination charges will not exceed, in the aggregate, three (3) months' Charges for the terminated Services and will be Customer's sole liability and IBM's sole and exclusive remedy in respect of such termination.
